breakdown.description: Numerical method section contains conflicting time-integration / solver instructions.
breakdown.reason: The original prompt contained conflicting instructions for the numerical method, specifying both 'Explicit forward Euler' and a detailed 'Strang splitting' scheme. The ground truth resolved this by removing the incorrect 'Explicit forward Euler' instruction. The generated specification failed to fix this conflict; it included both methods, stating 'Use Strang splitting method' under 'Numerical Method' and 'Use explicit forward Euler method' under 'Time Integration', thereby preserving the original ambiguity.
